youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Mera wazan zyada hai, behoshi safe hai?" ⚖️
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Uncle, wazan se operation nahi rukta — bas taiyaari chahiye! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Aajkal ka anaesthesia bahut safe hai — zyada wazan wale log bhi aksar wahi operation karwa sakte hain
✅ Neend mein saans rukti ho ya bahut kharraate aate hon, toh doctor ko bataiye; saans ki machine (CPAP) use karte hain toh saath laaiye
✅ Operation se pehle jitna ho sake chaliye-phiriye aur santulit khaana khaiye — chhote badlaav bhi recovery behtar karte hain
✅ Operation ke baad jaldi uthkar chaliye — isse khoon ke thakke (clot) ka khatra kam hota hai
Wazan ki koi dawa ya injection le rahe hain toh doctor ko zaroor bataiye — khud band mat kijiye, doctor se poochhiye

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
